Actual generated outputs from bounded trials

Each grid shows 32 samples per class, fixed noise seed 101. First four rows: cat. Last four rows: dog. No training photographs are embedded.

Inspect structure, variety and class agreement. Losses and pixel diversity do not establish semantic quality. Zero duplicate pairs can coexist with poor images. A short single-seed pilot cannot validate a pet-image recipe or quantum advantage.

Manual inspection of these short trials still shows blurry textures and blobs; no convincing pet-image improvement is demonstrated.
